headline: 2 high-relevance development(s) across 2 jurisdiction(s); DE leads.

body.text: New this period: Germany publishes its draft transposition bill: reporting from 100 employees, fines up to €100,000, consultation to 30 September. Italy transposes the Pay Transparency Directive; annual reporting from 100 employees, first report due 30 June 2027.
Prioritise DE: Germany publishes its draft transposition bill: reporting from 100 employees, fines up to €100,000, consultation to 30 September.

Also on the radar: Corrigendum to the Italian transposition decree: 100–149 employee reporters owe a first report in 2027; Italy fixes the filing channel and window for the pay-gap report: Servizi Lavoro portal, 1 March to 30 June 2027; Italian labour inspectorate: headcount is the prior-year average, per legal entity; inspections start only after the first deadline.
